text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae's town revitalizing project steadily became a hot topic, bringing in more and more visitors!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, my, we're super busy, aren't we?
As the landlady, I've got to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well isn't that a surprise!
A bunch of new hot springs opened up too, so I guess it's a synergy effect.

A few of the celebrated Umamusume featured in the
exhibition also began to arrive here and there.
All of them reunited with the landladies with bright smiles.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, so many familiar faces.
Everyone remembered the days spent here, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Geez, as long as you're healthy and doing well,
that's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Even if this ryokan disappeared,
I'd just thought of it as the sign of the times, but...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"After everyone went this far for me,
I can't let myself be crushed so easily!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...! This hot spring really is deeply loved, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Proprietress,
we'll help out around here even more!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we're truly grateful.
We gotta pull our own weight too!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
With more visitors expected after watching the video,
we'll need even more hands on deck.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, leave it to me.
I wouldn't want people seeing it in person and being disappointed, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We must live up to expectations and secure repeat customers.
Digging more hot springs and building new bath facilities going forward is an absolute must.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
it looks fine to expand
the excavation area."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are still plenty of spots left to dig.
Though they are in rather tricky locations.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: If we dig well, we might even discover a spring with brand-new mineral qualities!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's do it, everyone! Let's build new hot springs one after another~~!
